row.notes: Builds one R&D upgrade card for the UI: creates VM child node "entry_%u" under the list node at screen+0xAF8, runs Ui_Rnd_BuildUpgradeCardBinding, then Career_Update_RnDUpgradeCardText (MyTeam, also sets a bool node true) or Career_Update_RnDProgressPausedText. Cost = Career_Get_EffectiveUpgradeCost(career, upgrade_id, team, 1); writes cost - cost*discount_pct/100 and -discount_pct into two s32 card nodes and VM ints "prior_cost", "prior_discount_percent", "display_cost", "display_discount" (from prior_discount_pct). If slot_index < 15 it copies the 37 node handles into screen+0xB10+slot*0x4A0 and 21 detail handles into screen+0x5090+slot*0x2A0 (Career_Bind_UpgradeCard with k_Career_UpgradesComponentDesc from screen+0x7828). Called from 0x141800ff0. Hook here to change displayed R&D prices/discounts.
